main_text.l: Part.Praeterit. בָּנָה Ædificata fuerat, Esr.5.11. Infinit. לִבְנָא Ædificare, Esr.5.2. vel מ ejecto & per Dagesch compensato, לִבְנָא, v.3. Cum ה paragogico, לִבְנִיָה Ædificandi, v.9. Futur. יִבְנוֹן Ædificanto; Esr.6.7. Niph. Præter. נִבְנָה Ædificata fuerat, 1.Reg.3.2. Part. הַנִּבְנֶה Quæ ædificata fuerit, 1.Par.22.19. Infin. לְהִבָּנוֹת Ut ædificaretur, Hag.1.2. Futur. אִבָּנֶה Ædificabor; Liberos consequar, Genes.16.2. & 30.3. Chald. ex Ithp. Partic. מִתְבְּנֵא Ædificatur, Esr.5.8. Futur. יִתְבְּנָא Ædificabi-tur, v.6. תִּתְבְּנֵא Ædificabitur, Esr.4.13.
בִּנְיָן m. Idem; verf.12. Chald. בִּנְיָנָא Esr.5.4.
מִבְנֶה m. Structura: Constr. כְּמִבְנֵה־עִיר Quasi structura civitatis, Ezech.40.2.
תַּבְנִית f. Structura: Similitudo; Exemplar, Forma: Aff. תַּבְנִיתוֹ Similitudinem illius, 2.Reg.16.10.

בֵּן m. Filius; latè: Gener, 1.Sam.24.17. Pullus, Lev.12. v.6. Ramus, Genes.49.22. Psalm.80.16. Constr. בֶּן; & quandoq; בִּן, ut Deuter. 25.2. Cum י paragogico, בְּנוֹ בְעוֹר Filius Behoris, Numer.24.v.3. cui simile vide in Nomine חָיָּה: Aff. בְּנוֹ Filius ejus, בְּנִי Filius meus, בִּנְךָ Filius tuus, בִּנֵּנוּ Filius noster, &c. Plural: בָּנִים Filii; Nepotes, Posteri: Pulli, Job.39.19. Discipuli, doctrinâ & institutione fili. Vide R.Salomon. Deuteron.6.v.7. Constr. בְּנֵי Gen.6.v.21. Aff. וּבְנֵיהֶם Et pulli earum, Gen.32.15. בָּנָיו Filii ejus, Genes.46.7. Chald. בְּנֵי Filii, Dan.2.25. וּבְנֵי תוֹרִין Et filii boum, id est, Juvenci, Esr.6.9. בְּנֵיהֵן Filii eorum, Dan.6.24. וּבְנוֹהִי Et filiorum ejus, Esr.6.10.
בַּת f. Filia, quasi ex בִּנָּה, ut Dagesch ostendit in formâ Affixorum, tum etiam ejus Plurale. Sic est אַף Ira; ex אַנָּה [?]. Metaphoricè quoq; hoc nomine appellantur Oppida,

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are copied as far as legible; the vowel points and several Hebrew tokens in the small type are uncertain and carry [?]. The second page number "33" at top right is doubtful. The printed text is "Ædificanto" and "Oppida," as shown. The catchword "Pagis" is partly cut off at the edge of the scan.
